assistant.description: Generic helper: anything delegated that needs both hands - inspect, change, run, check. Use when no narrower subagent fits. Gets the main agent's tools.

coder.description: Implement or fix code in the working tree: reads, edits, runs commands and tests. Best of the two PC models at code, and the faster one to decode.

reviewer.description: Review a diff or audit files and report findings. No edit/write; read-only by convention, since bash is available.

researcher.description: Investigate a question against the web, upstream docs or the local nixpkgs checkout, and report what was found with sources. Writes nothing.
